title: SciDocBench: A Workflow-Centered Benchmark and Data Pipeline for Scientific Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.05141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific papers require models to reason jointly over text, equations, figures, tables, code, and datasets while preserving the provenance of supporting evidence. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear whether multimodal models can support realistic scientific-reading workflows. We introduce SciDocBench, a workflow-centered benchmark for scientific document understanding. It contains 124 expert-authored and difficulty-screened questions organized into seven research-assistant capability groups and 19 subtasks across five scientific domains. Each question is instantiated under four matched conditions combining English or Chinese questions with all-images-first or interleaved document representations, yielding 496 evaluation instances for controlled analysis. translated_title: SciDocBench：面向科学文档理解的以工作流为中心的基准测试与数据流水线
translated_abstract: 科学论文要求模型能够对文本、公式、图形、表格、代码和数据集进行联合推理，同时保留支持性证据的来源信息。现有基准测试通常孤立地评估这些能力，导致多模态模型能否支持真实的科学阅读工作流尚不明确。我们提出了SciDocBench，一个面向科学文档理解的以工作流为中心的基准测试。它包含124道由专家编写并经过难度筛选的问题，这些问题被组织为七个科研助手能力组和19个子任务，涵盖五个科学领域。每个问题在四种匹配条件下进行实例化，即将英文或中文问题与全图优先或交错式文档表示相结合，共产生496个评估实例用于对照分析。表现最强的评估系统仅获得62.6/100的分数，在文档感知、证据定位、可验证性等方面存在明显弱点。
tldr: SciDocBench是一个以科研工作流为中心的科学文档理解基准，包含124道专家编写的问题、覆盖五个领域的19个子任务，评估显示最强多模态模型仅得62.6分，表明当前模型在真实科学阅读任务上仍有显著差距。
en_tdlr: SciDocBench is a workflow-centered benchmark for scientific document understanding featuring 124 expert-authored questions across 19 subtasks in five scientific domains, revealing that even the strongest multimodal model achieves only 62.6/100, exposing significant weaknesses in realistic scientific reading workflows.
